messages.about.body: I write, produce, and release my own music, and I build the things around it too, like this site. ECU is my signature: everything I make carries it, whether it's a song or a line of code.

messages.studio.about.heading: About the studio
messages.studio.about.lead: MECU Interactive is an independent video game development studio founded by {name}.
messages.studio.about.body: Our vision is to combine creativity and technology to create game experiences with a character of their own. We are a new studio, and Wanderbud is the game we are building right now. Announcements, screenshots, and progress will be posted here and on Instagram.
messages.studio.about.p0.title: Play comes first
messages.studio.about.p0.body: If it is not fun to pick up and play, it is not ready. Everything else is built around that.
messages.studio.about.p1.title: Craft over shortcuts
messages.studio.about.p1.body: We would rather make one thing well than many things quickly.
messages.studio.about.p2.title: Open about the work
messages.studio.about.p2.body: We share progress as it happens, including the parts that are still rough.
